description: Official Unlayer skills for AI coding agents: embed the drag-and-drop editor, build templates in code with Unlayer Elements, custom tools, export, configuration, and the Image Editor.
rules: Install with `npx skills add unlayer/unlayer-skills`. The `unlayer` router skill picks the right sub-skill for a question.

Embedding the editor: unlayer-integration. Templates written in code: unlayer-elements. Custom blocks: unlayer-custom-tools. Export or save/load designs: unlayer-export. Features and security: unlayer-config.

Use exact package names: react-email-editor, vue-email-editor, angular-email-editor, @unlayer/react-elements, and @unlayer/react-image-editor (the unscoped react-image-editor npm package is unrelated).
